title: 進路セミナーⅠ
subtitle: Career Planning Seminar I
educationalGoal:
The main subjects are the following three:
1. Practice in self-analysis and career design
2. Search for self-future direction with making to improve in job consciousness by expert-lecture sessions and factory inspections, etc.
3. Initiate activity with planning in the subjects required for a long period on the written exams of qualification acquisition, general common sense, and SPI, etc.
advice:
The class is carried out by a course unit.
1. Advice of career design and self-development
2. Grasp the basic ability level and overcome the weaknesses in electrical and electronic engineering (Integrated practice)
3. Aware of self-characteristics (advantages and disadvantages) and self-appeal
4. Lecture by expert working on -Attendance and whole discussions-
5. Research on companies
6. Research on business and industries related with electric occupations
7. Research on business and industries unrelated with electric occupations
8. For my career design -Integrated practice and whole discussions
requiredKnowledge: It is due to perform the career planning seminar I carried out at the current fiscal year towards job-hunting activities of next year, and to make the preparation and strategy to the severe job-hunting expected. All students need to take a lecture irrespective of a future direction, because it is necessary to make preparations of mental attitude and employment exam for job-hunting activities. Moreover, this study result serves as reference data of the employment placement in next year.

activityGoals.body: The relation between a life design and a career path can be considered deeply for your own self.
Thinking and action required in order to discover a suitable life path for yourself can be performed.
Your life plan and target can be drawn up yourself.
Knowledge, capability, and qualification required to achieve a life path are investigated.
